Commentary.Commentary: So it's only taken the Windies under 5 overs to deal with the Bangladesh tail and Only 9 runs were added in this time. Jomel Warrican was brought on and he made an instant impact. First got rid of Naeem Hasan and then, after a hiccup or two, managed to dismiss Mustafizur Rahman. The hosts would have liked to touch 350, but they certainly won't be disappointed with what they have on the board. Now it's up to the Windies to respond. Let's see how they do against the Tigers' spin attack on this slow and turning surface.

OUT! Mustafizur is gone this time! Warrican wraps things up in his first over. He once again bowls it around off, it's a tad short in length and turns in. Mustafizur is on the back foot to flick it away but is caught on the pads again. Another appeal ensues and the finger goes up again. The DRS is called into action once more and it's taken upstairs. This time, the replays show that the Fizz is gone for all money. BANGLADESH ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 324!
Another review. Same batsman, same call... for a leg before. Will Mustafizur survive again?
Works it off his pads on the leg side. Dot ball.

Safe! Well, well well... the impact is outside off. A good review in the end. Warrican lands it outside off and it spins back in, Rahman goes back to play at it but gets caught on the pads. Loud shout and the finger goes up. The Fizz, after talking to his partner, signals the 'T'. Replays show impact is outside off. So he survives.
Review taken. Mustafizur is caught leg before and given out. He's decided to take it upstairs. Looks close.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in for Bangladesh.

OUT! Good bowling. Warrican takes the wicket the moment he comes into the attack. This is what West Indies wanted. Tossed up outside off stump, Naeem looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards first slip where Shai Hope takes the catch. A handy partnership of 65 runs comes to an end. Bangladesh lose their 9th wicket.
Jomel Warrican is into the attack now.

There is a minute's silence before the start of play, in memory of match referee David Boone's mother who recently passed away.

Hello and welcome to Day 2 of this Chittagong Test. It was a lot of back and forth in terms of momentum on the first day. The hosts were cruising along well on the back of a century and a fifty stand, both involving centurion Mominul Haque, and were looking set for a big score, but Shannon Gabriel picked up 4 vital wickets in the space of 15 balls in the final session to bring his side back into the game. Though, Windies' failure to clean up the tail could prove costly as Taijul Islam and Naeem Hasan remained unbeaten at Stumps with a 56-run stand and the home side has crossed 300. The plan now for the visitors will be to take the remaining two wickets fast and come out to bat, while the Tigers will look to add as many as possible. The wicket is already turning a lot, and it will do even more, so expect a good, feisty contest today.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

This Test match is nicely set up now. We have seen the ball already turning on Day 1 itself and with Bangladesh having 4 spinners in their ranks, they will look to make the most of it. The tail, before that, will look to add as much as possible. Join us for Day 2 of this Test at 0930 local (0330 GMT). Till then, take care!

Apart from the third-ball wicket at the start of the day, Windies were not doing anything with the ball. They didn't trouble the hosts and let them get away with the game. But post Tea, Shannon Gabriel struck gold. He picked up Haque, Rahim, Mahmudullah and Shakib in the span of 15 balls and pegged back the home team. The tourists had a good chance to even bat on Day 1 but couldn't get rid of the last two wickets.

A fightback from both sides in a single day. In the end, one will say that Bangladesh will be the happier team. Not really, but just edged it. They lost the early wicket of Soumya Sarkar in the first over itself but then Mominul Haque and Imrul Kayes took control of things. The duo added 104 runs together for the 2nd wicket with the former scoring a well-deserved ton, his 8th in this format equaling Tamim Iqbal. Shakib Al Hasan then looked in command but fell to a Shannon Gabriel special. Just when Bangladesh looked like they would be bowled out today, Naeem Hasan and Taijul Islam wagged the tail and stitched an unbeaten 56-run partnership.

He angles this in on a length on middle, Rahim looks to play at it but is caught on the pads. Loud shout but the umpire doesn't bother. Gabriel speaks with Brathwaite and asks him to take the DRS. It goes upstairs and replays show all three reds on Ball Tracker. Bangladesh have been shook early after the Tea break.

Bangladesh have been resolute with their batting. Mithun got himself caught but Shakib has ensured no further damage has been made. Mominul Haque looks solid out there. He stroked his way to his 8th Test ton, the joint-most in this year. The hosts will hope he carries on along with the skipper and post a big total on the board. Join us in a short while for the last session of the day.

Full on middle stump, Haque flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on off stump, Mominul defends off the back foot.
FOUR! Good shot. Short of a length delivery, Mominul pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Kemar Roach returns to the attack.
Flighted ball, Shakib plays it to the off side.
Flatter ball on off, Haque punches it through mid off to give his partner the strike.
Covers his stump, gets behind the ball and sees it out.

There it is! 100 for Mominul Haque. His 8th Test hundred and he now equals Tamim Iqbal for the most number of Test hundreds for Bangladesh. This ball was a tad short outside off, he cuts it through backward point and the ball races away to the fence to bring up his 6th century on this ground.
Tosses this one up outside off, Shakib drives it to extra cover. They jog to complete the run.
Loopy ball on off, played back to the bowler.
SIX! Beautiful shot. Flighted delivery on middle stump, Haque dances down the track and hits it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Haque flicks it towards the leg side.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Shakib sweeps it towards square leg. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up again on middle stump, the batsman gets it off his pads.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Shakib plays it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle stump, Haque looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads past short leg. The batsmen take a quick single.
Leans into this tossed up ball and wrists it away through mid-wicket for three good runs.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Opens the face of the bat, goes with the spin and pushes it to the man at cover-point.
Closes the face and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Darts it again. Quicker outside off, pushed away past silly point to cover.
Quicker one outside off, touch short in length, cut away but straight to point.
Darts this outside off, Haque cuts it to point.
Gets behind then ball this time and bunts it out.

Bishoo is getting the ball to speak. Bowls a lovely leg spinner on off, Haque is forward to block it but gets rapped in front. Windies thought about the review but then decided against it. Seems that the umpire and the players have got it spot on. Replays later on show us that there was a feather before Haque was caught in front of the stumps.
Full and on the pads, helped on its way to short fine leg for a single.
Another stifled appeal which dies down. Shakib goes back to turn it away but gets hit on his leg outside leg.

Half-hearted shout for a leg before, turned down! Tossed up on middle stump, Shakib looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show that it was umpire's call as the ball was clipping leg stump.
Full around off, driven past the mid off region for one. Good over, just the run from it.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, hit back to the bowler.
Outside off, driven firmly to covers but straight to the man stationed there.
Down leg this time, Shakib plays it onto the ground to the on side.
A bit full on off again, tapped in front of silly point.
Full and on off, driven to short cover.
Tossed up again on off stump, Haque drives it towards covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Shakib plays it towards mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Flighted delivery again on off stump, Haque plays it towards third man. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Shakib rocks back and cuts it towards point. The batsmen change ends.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Shakib defends off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off stump, Shakib tucks it towards short leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Loopy ball on off, Haque gets behind the ball and bunts it down.
Another ball driven through covers for just a run.
Down leg, Haque flicks it away through square leg for a run.
Low full toss outside off, Shakib drives it with power but it goes to extra cover for just one.
Pushed to the cover region by Shakib.
Roston Chase is back.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot through point. They pick up a single.
Full on leg stump, flicked fine down the leg side for a single.
Off the mark straightaway. Shakib punches it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Skipper Shakib Al Hasan walks into the middle next.

OUT! GONE! Windies have their breakthrough. The mini-break has worked wonders. Poor shot by Mithun. Tossed up again on middle stump, Mithun looks to go for a slog sweep over mid-wicket but gets a top edge. The ball just skies in the air above him. Shane Dowrich calls for it, settles under the ball and takes a safe catch. Budding stand of 48 is broken.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mithun defends off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Mithun cuts it towards point.

Drinks are on the field. Another solid partnership being built. Haque was dropped by Dowrich and he's on his way to making a century. Windies' sloppy display with regards to catching is costing them dearly. The southpaw, along with Mithun, is going along comfortably. Need more discipline from the visitors to get a wicket here.
Darted on the pads, spinning in, it's worked from the back foot behind square leg for two more.
Gives this plenty of air once more, blocked by coming well forward.
Floated outside the line of off stump, driven through the gap in the covers. A couple of runs are collected.
Makes good use of his feet. Seeing the flight on the ball, Haque comes out of his crease and flicks it aerially past Hetmyer at short mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Darts it on off, shorter and quicker in pace, dealt with easily.
Quicker through the air, fuller on off, Haque defends off the front foot.
BEATEN! Drifts away from the batsman, Mithun looks to defend but misses it completely and gets beaten on this one.
Tossed up again on middle stump, the batsman flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off stump, the batsman cuts it towards point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Haque dances down the track and tries to defend but gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up on middle stump, Haque plays it towards the leg side.
Positions himself well behind the line and guards it out safely.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Goes square this time. Taps it to point and gets to the other end.
Room on offer outside off, shorter in length, Haque backs away and slaps it through the cover region for one.
Turning away from outside off, it's knocked into the covers for an easy run.
Short and wide, Mithun misses out as he can't connect with the cut shot.
Jomel Warrican returns to the attack.
Tossed up on off stump, Mithun rocks back and cuts it towards covers. The batsmen take a run.
Short on middle stump, Haque pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Flighted delivery again on off stump, Haque defends off the front foot.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Mithun flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends it straight towards the bowler.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mithun defends off the back foot.
Full on middle stump, Mominul flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Good length delivery outside off stump, the batsman taps it to off side.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Haque offers no shot.
Full on middle stump, Mithun flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on off stump, Mithun defends off the back foot.
Short of a length delivery, Mominul pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Dropped short again, outside off, punched through covers for one more.
Short and wide, the punch is slapped through covers for a run.
Quite full but on leg stump, Mithun brings his bat ahead of his pad and works it on the leg side.
Landed on a driving length, Mithun strides forward and meets it with the full face.
Full and turning away from middle and off, the right-hander uses the depth of the crease to camp back and defend.
Full delivery on off stump, the batsman drives it towards mid off.
Again on a good length on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Length delivery on off stump, Haque defends off the back foot.
Full outside off stump, Haque drives it towards mid off.
Length delivery on leg stump, Mithun flicks it towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single.
Full on off stump, Mithun plays it towards covers.
Kemar Roach is called back on.

Dropped! Genuine edge and Haque survives. Second dropped chance of the innings. Floated leg spinner outside off, it turns it slightly as Haque prods forward to block. The ball takes a feather behind but Dowrich can't react in time and hold on to it.
Short ball outside off, punched down the ground to long off for a single.
Edged but safe! Bishoo nicely loops up the leg break around off, Mithun is drawn forward and looks to defend. The edge is induced but it goes just wide of first slip. A couple of runs are taken.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. Half tracker on the stumps, Mithun shifts his weight on the back foot and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Mominul goes with the spin, rocks on the back foot and turns it to square leg for one.
Spinning in from around off, Haque goes back and forces it to covers.
Devendra Bishoo is back into the attack.
Length ball blocked with the full face and that's the end of the over.
On the fifth stump line, no shot offered on that occasion.
Pounds it in short again and angles it in on middle, Mithun somehow manages to fend it away on the leg side.
Shortish in length, outside off, he rises and taps it down on the off side.
Short ball angling too far down leg, the right-hander ducks and evades.
Full delivery tailing back in, Mohammad Mithun tries to drive but gets it off the inner half on the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Haque defends off the back foot.
Full on off stump, Mithun drives it towards mid off. The batsmen take a run.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, the batsman drives it towards mid off. The batsmen cross ends.

Tossed up on off stump, the batsman tries to defend but gets past the inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes towards first slip. Windies players got excited for a catch but the ball was hit low on the pads. No bat was there.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Haque defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on off stump, Haque plays it towards mid on.
Outside off, arms are shouldered to let it through.
Back of a length just outside off, pushed back down the track from the back foot.
Short of a good length outside off, Mithun tries dragging the pull through mid-wicket but instead gets a thick inside edge onto his thigh pads.
Sharp from Gabriel. Bumper angling in on middle and leg, Mithun looks to let it go but can't get out of the way in time. Takes a blow on his left shoulder.
In the channel outside off, it's dropped down in front of point. Both batsmen take off quickly and complete the run with ease.
Good length delivery on off stump, Haque waits inside his crease and keeps it out safely.
Tossed up outside off stump, the batsman goes for the sweep but misses it.
Loopy delivery on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers.
FOUR! Good shot. Flighted delivery again on off stump, Mithun drives it straight towards long off for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Haque flicks it towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Tossed up on off stump, Mominul defends off the front foot.
Again a yorker on middle stump, the batsman digs it out towards cover.
Again full outside off stump, the batsman drives it towards covers.
Yorker on off stump, the batsman digs it out easily.
Again on a good length outside off stump, the batsman lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Mithun lets it go.
Full outside off stump, Mithun looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat.
Presses forward and buries this flighted ball into the track.
FOUR! Shot. Nicely tossed up outside off, too much room on offer though and Mominul takes full toll of it. Reaches out to the ball and drives it through the covers to find the fence.
Full delivery and it's driven towards mid off for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Opens the face, eases it to the covers but can't beat the fielder.
Spinning away from outside off, on a shorter length, Mithun goes back to push it away on the off side and gets it off the inner half.

Tries to bowl the yorker again but ends up bowling a high full toss wide outside off, Mominul hits it a bit square through cover-point. The man in the deep does up mopping up duty and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, pushed defensively from the back foot in front of covers.
Spears it full and attacks the stumps, drilled back down the track.
Quite full and well wide outside off, Haque drives it through cover-point. Sweeper cover moves to his right and cuts it off. Two runs to the total.
Good length delivery on off stump, kept out from within the crease.
Full length ball in line of the stumps, driven back down the track.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up on off, blocked by coming on the front foot.
We are back. Mominul Haque strides out to the middle with a new partner in Mohammad Mithun. Jomel Warrican to bowl the final ball of his pending over.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Something to smile about for the Windies before they head into the break. They got Kayes right at the stroke of Lunch. Roach got Sarkar out for a duck but since then, Kayes and Haque did well to take things in their stride and make a century stand, with the latter stroking a fine fifty. Imrul was given a couple of lives, where he had a catch dropped and was caught off a no ball too, and it seemed like this pair would see the session off. But, Warrican managed to get him late in this opening session. Bangladesh still firmly in control, having scored 105 runs, but this could be the opening the Windies needed. Let's see what happens in the afternoon session.

OUT! What a catch! Sunil Ambris at short leg takes a beauty. Flatter ball on middle, Kayes looks to work this on the leg side, but is a bit late in doing so. The ball goes straight to Sunil. He does not take it in the first attempt but then holds on to it near his chest. A good catch and this time Warrican has not overstepped. So, after two lives, Imrul Kayes has to walk. A very good 104-run stand comes to an end. That will also be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
FOUR! Lovely! Gets low and sweeps this ball from outside off over the mid-wicket region. The ball races to the boundary.
On off, gets an inside edge onto his pads trying to work it to the off side.
Imrul has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another reverse sweep from Kayes. Gets it fine to third man. Powell tidies it up to keep the batsmen to two to bring up the 100 for the hosts.
Enough time for Kayes to rock back and punch the ball to the off side. Kayes will keep strike for the next over.
Leg spinner on leg, turned away with the spin.
A bit short again. Gets the ball to come in. Haque plays it with a straight bat through covers for one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short ball but there is a man back. Half tracker on middle, Haque pulls it over mid-wicket for just one.
Leg spinner down leg, worked away towards square leg to change strike.
Devendra Bishoo to have a burst.
Goes back and whips this straight to the man at square leg. Dot ball.
Gets ahead and bunts this ball next to the 22 yards.
Rocks back and whips this through square leg for a run.
The physio is out to have a look at Kayes' left knee. That must have stung a lot, hopefully it's not too serious, just an impact pain. The magic spray is out to do its thing.
After playing a good shot he now gets himself injured. Arm ball on off, Kayes looks to drive it. The extra turn on that ball gets an inside edge onto his knee roll.
FOUR! Kayes coming to the party. He has been good with his sweeps and gets one to the boundary now. Swipes this from down leg and over the square leg region for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Haque gets to the ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Full in length, drifting in from around off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Bit quicker through the air, on off, blocked right under his nose.
Looped up delivery on middle and off, driven down to long off for another run.

13th Test fifty for Mominul Haque! A good knock since he's come out to bat. Has been completely chanceless. Flighted delivery again on off stump, Haque drives it through covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Kayes drives it towards mid off. Single taken.
Tossed up on off stump, Haque drives it towards mid off. The batsmen take a run.
Kayes has been struck on the pads outside leg as he looked to play that off the front foot.
Comes down the track and eases this through covers. One more run taken.
Down the leg side, worked on the on side.
Uses his feet and looks to go big. Ends up giving it to the mid-wicket fielder along the turf.
On middle and leg, Haque taps this one in front of the short leg fielder.
Very good cricket. Plays this with soft hands to the off side and immediately sets off for a run. In the end complete it with ease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit short again. Kayes goes inside his crease and punches it through covers. One run added to the total.
Flatter ball on off, Kayes goes back and defends it off his back foot.
Tossed up ball on off, Haque drives it through covers. A run taken.
The short of a length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side but straight to the man.
On off, Haque looks to block it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Loopy ball on off, Kayes keeps it out.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. A stifled appeal which dies down.
Jomel gives this air on off, Kayes takes a couple of steps but blocks it.
Imrul flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Already turn on day 1. The straighter one outside off, Haque is forward but gets an edge away from the cordon for a single.
A bit short on off, Haque pulls it to mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Given air on midlde and off, Kayes blocks it off the middle of the bat.
Outside off, Haque guides it to third man for just one.
Flighted ball on middle, Haque plays it onto the ground.
Haque has pushed it to the cover region.
Arm ball on leg. The ball hits the pads of Haque but it was way down leg.
Comes ahead and blocks it ball off his front foot.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Goes away from the left-hander who taps it to the on side.
Arm ball on off, Kayes stays back and sees this off.
FOUR! Good shot! Knew where the fielders were. Gets on one knee for this loopy ball and sweeps it over short fine leg. Boundary.
Way down leg. Kayes shuffles but leaves it alone.
On middle and off, Kayes shows the full face and defends it.
In the gap away from the mid off fielder for a run.
Outside off again. Kayes goes for the drive but cannot time it well enough. Gives it straight to the man at short covers.
Flat on off, Kayes bunts it down.
Flighted ball on middle, Kayes negotiates it well.
Outside off, driven to covers.
On middle and leg, Haque gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. One run added to the total.
Gives this air, Kayes plays a reverse sweep towards point.
Flighted delivery again on middle stump, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Tossed up again on middle stump, the batsman flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Kayes defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on leg stump, Kayes flicks it towards square leg.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. 12 from it. A bit on the shorter side outside off, Haque waits for it and cuts it through point for the third boundary of the over.
Loopy ball on off, Haque is forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up on off, Haque leans forward and blocks it out.
FOUR! Even better! Super strike. This time uses his feet. Floated ball on middle and leg, Haque comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Mominul defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Short and flat on middle and off, Haque goes deep in his crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, the batsman blocks it well.
Tossed up on middle stump, Kayes defends off the back foot.
Spinning in on leg, Kayes goes back to flick. Gets some bat on it and it falls just short of the leg slip fielder.
FOUR! Full toss on the stumps, Kayes gets into position early, brings out the reverse sweep and takes it on the full. Places it through backward point and finds the fence.

BYES! RUN OUT CHANCE! NOT OUT! Flighted delivery on leg stump, Kayes gets it off his pads and it goes through fine leg. The fielder does well to stop it and throws it to the keeper. The keeper dislodges the bails but the batsman was well in. The batsmen pick up a couple.
A run out appeal against Imrul Kayes is referred upstairs.
Tossed up on leg stump, Kayes flicks it towards fine leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Full in length, some nice drift again as it's around off, driven to covers. Dot ball.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Comes ahead and eases it to the mid off fielder.
Tossed up on off, the southpaw comes forward and dead-bats it.
Peach! Slow through the air, lands on off and then spins away slightly, Haque comes half forward to defend but gets beaten.
FOUR! Short, wide and spinning away from outside off, Haque rocks onto the back foot and places the cut behind point for a fine boundary. The 50-run stand comes up with that.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and leg, Kayes works it off his pads.
Full and on off this time, Kayes gets behind the ball and bunts it down.
Down leg again, worked around the corner.
Floated ball down leg, blocked by Kayes.

NO BALL! Oh dear! Kayes finds the only man in the deep and gets caught. But guess what? The umpire asks Kayes to wait and finds out that Jomel has overstepped. Second life for the opener. Coming to the ball, it was tossed up on leg, Kayes goes low and slogs it. Finds Shannon Gabriel at deep mid-wicket who takes the catch.
Tossed up on middle stump, Kayes pushes it towards the leg side.
Jomel Warrican into the attack now. Spin from both ends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Stifled shout for a leg before, turned down. Chase wasn't even interested, rightly so too. Big inside edge on that. Drifting in from around off, Haque comes forward to defend, the ball raps him on the pads but not before taking the edge.
Imrul picks it off his pads and clips it through backward square leg for one.
Spinning away from around off, pushed square towards point.
Goes against the spin and flicks this through backward square leg. A single is taken as the man in the deep mops it up.
Starts from around the wicket and drifts it in on middle and off, Mominul comes forward and keeps it out.
Drinks break. Also, Roston Chase is into the attack.
Short of a length delivery, the batsman pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on off stump, Haque drives it towards mid off.
Full on leg stump, Kayes flicks it towards fine leg for a single.

In Gabriel's previous over, there was some tussle between him and Kayes. Shannon just got in the way of Kayes while the batsmen were crossing. Earlier on too, the umpire had a word with the two of them.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Length ball on off stump, Kayes defends off the back foot.
FOUR! Good shot. Length delivery outside off stump, Kayes comes forward and drives it through point for a beautiful boundary.
Full and on off, punched to covers. After 10 overs, Bangladesh are 38/1.
Down leg again. Kayes works it through square leg this time for one more.
On the pads of Haque. He turns it away through mid-wicket for another run.
Pleasant drive. Full and outside off, Haque leans forward and drives it through cover-point. No boundary but the fielder hares behind it and the batsmen take two.
Full and outside off, Haque plays it with soft hands to backward point. Dot ball.
Back of a length ball on the hips of Kayes. Imrul hops and tucks it away for one.
Length delivery outside off stump, Haque taps it towards the off side.
Full outside off stump, Mominul drives it through covers. The fielder runs fast and stops it before the boundary rope. The batsmen get two runs.
Full on middle stump, the batsman plays it towards square leg. The batsmen get a single.
Short outside off stump, the batsman cuts it towards covers.
Length delivery on middle stump, Kayes again defends off the front foot.
Good length delivery on off stump, Kayes defends off the front foot.
Outside off on a good length, let through by Haque.
Short of a length ball angling in on leg, fended away on the leg side off the thigh pad. A leg bye taken.
Fired full, well outside off, Kayes fails to find the gap through the covers.

FOUR RUNNING RUNS! Great timing on that shot from Imrul Kayes. He plants his front foot forward and drives this full ball past mid off. Jomel Warrican hares after it and keeps it just inside the rope, but the batsmen run hard and get four anyway.
Switches the angle to around the wicket, it's angling in at first and then moves away, Kayes defends it off the outer half behind square on the off side.
No ball! Back of a length on middle and leg, it's worked through mid-wicket for a single. Another no ball, as Gabriel overstepped once more.
From over the wicket, it's angling across on a back of a length, Haque pushes it with the angle on the off side.
Taps this into the cover-point area and manages to take the single.
Good carry for Roach. He serves it in the off stump channel, the batsman lets it be.
Fullish in length and outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Leans into this full delivery and drives it to the mid off fielder.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Rising off the deck from a good length, quite close to off, guarded out without much trouble.
Full length delivery angling in on middle and leg, wristed away straight to short mid-wicket.
Fires it full again, goes for another yorker, on off this time, Kayes jams it out once more.
Yorker on off, Imrul crouches a bit and digs it out.
Stays inside the crease, watches the ball and defends.
No ball! Gabriel bangs it in short and angles it in, Haque pulls it to the square leg fielder. No ball signalled as the pacer overstepped his line.
Angles it across on a length, on the off stump, Haque stays right behind the line and taps it down in front of covers.
Fuller length ball on the off stump, a straight bat is presented in response.
Outside off, left alone.
Flashes hard. Full again on off, comes back in. Kayes looks to loft it but the ball goes under his bat. Needs to be careful.

DROPPED! Beauty from Roach. He gets the outside edge but Chase fails to hold on to one. Fuller length ball around off, Kayes looks to play it with a straight bat but gets an outside edge towards second slip. Roston gets low but the ball does not stick. Kayes gets away with it and will look to make the most of his chance now.
Similar length. Had the batsman in two minds. Haque goes back but gets an inside edge towards the on side for one.
On a good length on that fifth stump line. Mominul waits for it and taps it in front of him.
Full and on off, Haque drives it to short covers.
Down the leg side. Kayes tries to whip it away but it goes off his pad to the keeper.
Pitches it further up around off, Haque firmly punches it towards mid on. A bit of a teaser for the fielder who manages to keep it to three.
FOUR! Too straight in line and Gabriel pays the price for it. Shortish in length and into the body, Haque moves inside the line and helps the pull through backward square leg for a boundary.
Coming in at first and then shaping away quite late, the bat turns in Haque's hands as he defends it down on the off side.
Marginally ahead of a length, on the off stick, kept out with the full face of the bat.
Gabriel with the yorker once more, hits his mark too, Mominul manages to keep it at bay.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Some width on offer outside off, it's punched square to point for nothing.
Short of a length outside the line of off stump, punched away into the off side.
Fraction straight in line, the opener moves inside the line and wrists it to short mid-wicket.
Rising off the deck as it lands on a length, on the fourth stump line, another leave from the batsman.
Excellent! Keeps it just outside off, a length delivery. Imrul Kayes moves a step across, covers the line and shoulders arms to it.
Fires in an accurate yorker, on off, dug out back down the track to end the over.
FOUR! Shot. Right in the gap. Short and wide outside off, Mominul Haque stands tall and cracks this square past point for a rocketing boundary.
Angling down the leg side, on a good length, the batsman looks to flick it away but misses.
Mominul hangs on the back foot on this occasion and blocks with a straight bat.
FOUR! Full and angling in on the pads, easy enough for Haque to flick it away behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Goes full straightaway and attacks the stumps, Haque defends it from inside the crease.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl from the other end. Three slips and a gully positioned for him as well.
Nice shape on this as Roach pitches it on a length around off, Kayes gets a thick edge which flies past the diving gully fielder for a couple of runs.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery on off, Haque gets an inside edge down towards fine leg for a single. He's off the mark.
Mominul Haque is in at no.3.

OUT! Edged and gone! Perfect start for Roach and Windies. The perfect delivery. He lands it on a length close to off, it comes in and then straightens up a shade after hitting the deck. Sarkar has no choice but to play at it and he gets a feather behind. Dowrich takes a regulation catch. Not the comeback Sarkar would have hoped for, coming back into the Test side after more than a year.
Fuller length ball on the stumps, Sarkar pushes it back down towards mid on.
Starts off from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Kayes works it behind square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Out come the players. Imrul Kayes and Soumya Sarkar will open for the home side, while Kemar Roach will take the new ball first up. Three slips and a gully in place for him. Here we go...

Kraigg Brathwaite says there will be something on offer in the first hour or something so wants to take advantage of that. Is really looking forward to the challenge. Reckons that the batsmen are doing well so hopes they can continue with that. On Jason Holder missing out, he says he'll be a big miss but the boys will buck up and give their best.

Shakib Al Hasan says he's excited to be back after a long injury lay off. Mentions that it's an important series for them and Windies will be a stern challenge. On their opening woes, he states that they want to forget the past and just focus on the present. Ends by saying that they are playing with four spinners.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and elect to bat first!

Pitch Report - Tino Mawoyo out in the middle says that the wicket is really dry and there are already a few cracks in the area which will be more prominent as the game progress. Adds that 289 is the average score on Day 1, so the team winning the toss should bat first and come out and put pressure on the other side.

Hello and welcome for another tour in this part of the subcontinent. Zimbabwe were here just a few days ago, and now Windies have travelled for a 2-match Test series against Bangladesh. Before this series has even begun, the visitors have been dealt a huge blow with Jason Holder missing out due to a shoulder injury. Kraigg Brathwaite will take over the captaincy reins in his absence, and it will be interesting to see how he leads the side out. The Tigers, well, did well to draw against the Chevrons. They will take some momentum from that and the fact that their talisman and regular skipper Shakib Al Hasan has returned from injury. You'd tip the scales in the hosts' favour for now, but we've all learnt from time to time, it's a world belonging to the unexpected. The toss and other updates to come soon....
